name: carry the rounding error of each addition into the next
mechanism: after adding a term to the running sum, recover what was lost to rounding by subtracting back, and add that lost piece to the next term before it is summed; the error no longer grows with the number of terms

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Kahan summation algorithm' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Elementary and special functions: a more accurate method of summing floating-point numbers

requires: rounding that is deterministic and recoverable by subtraction
fails_when: compilers that reassociate the arithmetic remove the correction
